<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Handler for PHINodes that define the value argument to an @llvm.expect call.</p>


<p>If the operand of the phi has a constant value and it 'contradicts' with the expected value of phi def, then the corresponding incoming edge of the phi is unlikely to be taken. Using that information, the branch probability info for the originating branch can be inferred.</p>


<p>Definition at line 116 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/transforms/lib/transforms/scalar/lowerexpectintrinsic-cpp">LowerExpectIntrinsic.cpp</a>.</p>
